title: Thilina R. Withanage
text:
I am a logical, hardworking, and committed statistical researcher and academic currently pursuing a Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Statistics at the School of Mathematical Sciences, Adelaide University.
I am passionate about data-driven problem solving, statistical modelling, teaching, and knowledge sharing. My long-term goal is to contribute to academia through high-quality research, innovative statistical methodologies, and interdisciplinary collaborations.

title: Thilina R. Withanage
text:
Research Interests
Predictive Outbreak Modelling
Integrating mathematical and statistical models with field data to improve forecasting of ecological and agricultural pest outbreaks.
Time Series Analysis & Forecasting
Classical, state-space, and structural time series models for economic, environmental, and industrial applications.
Computational Statistics & Data Science
Statistical learning, predictive modelling, Bayesian methods, and reproducible research using R, Python, and SAS.
